[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested 10 vegan dinner ideas that use common ingredients and are easy to make.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested recipes include Vegan Lentil Soup, Roasted Vegetable Quinoa Bowl, Black Bean and Sweet Potato Enchiladas, Spaghetti with Marinara and Vegetables, Vegan Chickpea Curry, Grilled Vegetable Wrap, Baked Vegan Mac and Cheese, Stuffed Bell Peppers, Vegan Fried Rice, and Vegan Chili.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended some vegan Indian recipe books: "The Indian Vegan Kitchen" by Madhu Gadia, "Vegan Richa's Indian Kitchen" by Richa Hingle, "The Vegan Indian Cookbook" by Priya Krishna, and "Indian Cooking Without Meat" by Yamuna Devi.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended websites for vegan Indian recipes: Vegan Richa (veganricha.com), Holy Cow! Vegan Recipes (holycowvegan.net), Indian Vegan Recipes (indianveganrecipes.com), and Manjula's Kitchen (manjulaskitchen.com).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested YouTube channels: Vegan Richa, Manjula's Kitchen, and Indian Vegan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned Facebook groups: Vegan India and Indian Vegan Recipes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of common Indian spices and blends to have in the pantry: Turmeric, Red Chili Powder, Coriander Powder, Cumin Powder, Garam Masala, Ginger, Cinnamon, Cardamom, Clove, Fenugreek Leaves, Mustard Seeds, Cumin Seeds, Fennel Seeds, and Asafoetida.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained how to use Chana Masala and Tandoori Masala blends in recipes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For Chana Masala, assistant suggested making Chana Masala Curry, Chana Masala Soup, and Chana Masala Salad.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For Tandoori Masala, assistant suggested making Tandoori Chickpeas, Tandoori Tofu, and Tandoori Vegetables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making a good curry sauce from scratch, including starting with a flavorful oil and caramelizing onions.
